=== FILE: verification_plan.yaml ===
# Verification plan: irq_ctrl
# Serves requirement req-5fc7831312: Verify the existing interrupt controller RTL.
# Specification: interface_spec.md (approved upstream interface_spec).
# This plan states intent only. Nothing in it is verified until a passing,
# cited run backs it.
# Test items need simulation of tb_irq_ctrl.sv.
# Assertion items need a formal run, or a quiet simulation, of irq_ctrl_sva.sv
# bound to the DUT.
# Coverage points are not yet planned: they are proven on design files, and
# the RTL file name is not yet known to this plan.

block: irq_ctrl
spec: interface_spec.md

requirements:
  - id: IRQ-PARAM
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "The block works for every `N` from 2 to 32, and bits `N` and up of the `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` registers read as zero and ignore writes."
  - id: IRQ-RESET
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "While `rst_n` is low at a rising edge of `clk`, `ENABLE`, `MODE` and `PENDING` clear to zero and the remembered level of every source clears to zero."
  - id: IRQ-REG-RW
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A write to `ENABLE` or `MODE` stores `wdata` bits `N-1` to 0 in that register."
  - id: IRQ-READ
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A read never changes any register; `rdata` follows `addr` with no clock edge."
  - id: IRQ-LEVEL
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A high-level source sets its `PENDING` bit at every rising edge where its input is high."
  - id: IRQ-EDGE
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A rising-edge source sets its `PENDING` bit at a rising edge where its input is high and was low at the previous rising edge, so an input held high sets it once."
  - id: IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "Detection does not depend on `ENABLE`: a disabled source still sets its `PENDING` bit."
  - id: IRQ-W1C
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A write to `PENDING` clears each bit written 1 and leaves each bit written 0 unchanged; it never sets a bit."
  - id: IRQ-ACK
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A write to `CLAIM` acknowledges the source whose number is in `wdata` bits 4 to 0: that source's `PENDING` bit clears and no other bit changes; a number of `N` or more changes nothing."
  - id: IRQ-SET-WINS
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A source detected at the same rising edge as a write that clears its bit keeps its `PENDING` bit set, so a high-level source acknowledged while its input is still high stays pending."
  - id: IRQ-MASK
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "`irq` is high exactly when some source has both its `PENDING` and its `ENABLE` bit set, for high-level and rising-edge sources alike."
  - id: IRQ-PRIORITY
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "`irq_id` is the lowest-numbered source whose `PENDING` and `ENABLE` bits are both set, so source 0 has the highest priority, and it is 0 while `irq` is low."
  - id: IRQ-CLAIM
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "A read of `CLAIM` returns `irq` in bit 31 and `irq_id` in bits 4 to 0, with every other bit zero."
  - id: IRQ-LATENCY
    source: interface_spec.md
    text: "`irq` and `irq_id` follow the registers with no clock edge, so a source detected at one rising edge drives `irq` until the next."

items:
  - id: test_smoke
    kind: test
    file: tb_irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-RESET, IRQ-LEVEL, IRQ-MASK, IRQ-CLAIM]
    description: "Stimulus: reset, enable source 0 in level mode, raise src[0], read CLAIM, write PENDING bit 0 with src[0] low. Check: PENDING reads 0x1 and irq is high after the edge, CLAIM reads 0x80000000, and PENDING and irq clear after the W1C write."
  - id: test_param_sweep
    kind: test
    file: tb_irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-PARAM]
    description: "Stimulus: run the full directed suite with N = 2, 8, 31 and 32, and write all-ones to ENABLE, MODE and PENDING. Drive every source, including source N-1. Check: bits N and up of ENABLE, MODE and PENDING read 0 after the writes, and source N-1 is detected, masked and claimed correctly."
  - id: test_reset_values
    kind: test
    file: tb_irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-RESET]
    description: "Stimulus: set ENABLE, MODE and PENDING nonzero and hold an edge-mode source high. Assert rst_n low for one edge while the source stays high, then release reset. Check: all three registers read 0 after reset. Then set MODE for that source and keep its input high. Because the remembered level was cleared to 0, the first edge after the MODE write sets PENDING once."
  - id: test_reg_rw
    kind: test
    file: tb_irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-REG-RW]
    description: "Stimulus: write walking-ones, walking-zeros and random patterns to ENABLE and MODE. Check: each read returns wdata[N-1:0], and the other register is unchanged."
  - id: test_read_side_effects
    kind: test
    file: tb_irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-READ]
    description: "Stimulus: with pending, enabled sources present and we low, sweep addr over 0..3, including changes between clock edges. Check: rdata matches the addressed register combinationally in the same cycle. ENABLE, MODE, PENDING, irq and irq_id are unchanged by any number of reads, including repeated CLAIM reads."
  - id: test_level_detect
    kind: test
    file: tb_irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-LEVEL]
    description: "Stimulus: level-mode source held high for several edges, cleared by W1C each cycle. Check: PENDING is set again at every edge where the input is high, and stays clear once the input is low and the bit is cleared."
  - id: test_edge_detect
    kind: test
    file: tb_irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-EDGE]
    description: "Stimulus: edge-mode source held high for many cycles and cleared by W1C after the first set. Also drive low-high-low pulses of one cycle and of several cycles. Check: a held-high input sets PENDING exactly once. Each low-to-high transition seen at consecutive rising edges sets PENDING once."
  - id: test_detect_disabled
    kind: test
    file: tb_irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED, IRQ-MASK]
    description: "Stimulus: ENABLE = 0, drive level and edge sources, then set the ENABLE bit. Check: PENDING bits set while disabled and irq stays low. irq rises in the same cycle that ENABLE is written."
  - id: test_w1c
    kind: test
    file: tb_irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-W1C]
    description: "Stimulus: with several PENDING bits set and inputs low, write PENDING with mixed patterns, including all-zeros and bits that are currently 0. Check: only bits written 1 clear, bits written 0 keep their value, and no bit is ever set by the write."
  - id: test_claim_ack
    kind: test
    file: tb_irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-ACK]
    description: "Stimulus: with several PENDING bits set and inputs low, write CLAIM with each ID 0..N-1 and with IDs N..31. Set junk in wdata bits 31..5. Check: only the named source's PENDING bit clears, and IDs >= N leave PENDING unchanged. Bits above 4 have no effect."
  - id: test_set_wins
    kind: test
    file: tb_irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-SET-WINS]
    description: "Stimulus: at the same edge, an edge-mode rising transition and a level-mode high input coincide with a W1C write of their bits, and separately with a CLAIM acknowledge of each. Check: PENDING stays set in every case. A level source acknowledged while still high remains pending and irq stays high."
  - id: test_priority
    kind: test
    file: tb_irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-PRIORITY, IRQ-CLAIM]
    description: "Stimulus: random PENDING/ENABLE combinations, including only source N-1, all sources, and pending-but-disabled lower sources. Claim and acknowledge repeatedly until irq drops. Check: irq_id and CLAIM bits 4..0 equal the lowest index of PENDING & ENABLE. irq_id is 0 and CLAIM reads 0 when irq is low."
  - id: test_latency
    kind: test
    file: tb_irq_ctrl.sv
    proves: [IRQ-LATENCY, IRQ-MASK]
    description: "Stimulus: detect a source at one edge, then change ENABLE and clear PENDING at later edges. Check, sampling just after each edge: irq and irq_id reflect the registers in the same cycle the registers change, with no extra cycle of delay. irq is high from the detecting edge until the edge that clears or masks the source."
  - id: assert_irq_mask
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-MASK, IRQ-LATENCY]
    description: "Always: irq == |(PENDING & ENABLE), evaluated combinationally on current register state."
  - id: assert_irq_priority
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-PRIORITY]
    description: "Always: irq_id equals the index of the lowest set bit of PENDING & ENABLE, and irq_id == 0 when irq is low."
  - id: assert_claim_format
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-CLAIM]
    description: "Always: when addr == 3, rdata == {irq, 26'b0, irq_id}."
  - id: assert_upper_bits_zero
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-PARAM]
    description: "Always: bits 31..N of ENABLE, MODE and PENDING are zero, and rdata bits 31..N are zero for addr 0..2."
  - id: assert_reset
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-RESET]
    description: "If rst_n is low at a rising edge, then at the next cycle ENABLE, MODE, PENDING and the remembered source level are all zero."
  - id: assert_pending_next
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-LEVEL, IRQ-EDGE, IRQ-DETECT-DISABLED, IRQ-W1C, IRQ-ACK, IRQ-SET-WINS]
    description: "Out of reset, the next value of each PENDING bit i is detect_i | (PENDING_i & ~clear_i). detect_i is src_i for level mode and src_i & ~prev_src_i for edge mode, independent of ENABLE. clear_i is (we & addr==2 & wdata_i) | (we & addr==3 & wdata[4:0]==i & i<N)."
  - id: assert_read_no_side_effect
    kind: assertion
    file: irq_ctrl_sva.sv
    proves: [IRQ-READ, IRQ-REG-RW]
    description: "If we is low, ENABLE and MODE keep their value at the next edge and PENDING changes only by detection. If we is high with addr 0 or 1, the addressed register takes wdata[N-1:0] and the other keeps its value. rdata always equals the register addr selects in the same cycle."
=== END FILE ===
